ownership_model.description: Device context owns XRT device, UUID, kernel. Backend context references device context and persistent engine. Registry owns device contexts.

xrt_initialization.description: Creates xrt::device and gets UUID in device_init_context. Does NOT load xclbin or create kernel. Kernel creation happens in persistent engine init_xrt.
xrt_initialization.status: PARTIAL - xclbin/kernel loading deferred to persistent engine

buffer_allocation.description: Buffer type uses malloc for host memory. Persistent engine allocates XRT BOs (inst_bo, weight_bo, input_bo[2], output_bo[2]) for device memory. Tensors stay in host memory until execution.
buffer_allocation.status: HYBRID - host buffers for tensors, XRT BOs for persistent execution

persistent_engine.description: Full XRT implementation with double-buffered async interface. Has init_xrt, submit, wait methods. Uses MLIR_AIE kernel with persistent instruction BO. Double-buffered input/output BOs for pipeline.

synchronous_points.description: graph_compute executes all ops synchronously in loop. synchronize() is no-op. event_record/wait are no-ops. Device caps report async=false, events=false.
synchronous_points.status: FULLY_SYNCHRONOUS - async infrastructure exists but not used

supports_op.description: Supports MUL_MAT with original (M=1, K=192, N=128) and Qwen SSM (M=1/2, K=1024, N=16) shapes for Q8_0/F32 types.

scheduler_assignment.description: offload_op = supports_op. Device reports caps.async=false, caps.events=false. Scheduler won't use async paths.

cpu_fallback.description: supports_buft allows CPU buffer type. If XDNA doesn't support op, falls back to CPU.

tensor_copy_path.description: cpy_tensor_async uses memcpy (synchronous host-to-host). No async DMA implementation.

graph_synchronization.description: event_new, event_free, event_synchronize, event_record, event_wait all return nullptr or no-op. Device reports no event support.

critical_gaps: Device caps report async=false, events=false - must be true for scheduler async
No XRT event implementation for cross-backend synchronization
graph_compute is synchronous - doesn't use persistent_engine submit/wait
synchronize is no-op - should wait for pending async operations
Backend doesn't connect to persistent engine's xclbin/insts paths
Async tensor copy not implemented (uses memcpy)

phase8_reference.async_model: pyxrt.run.start() / wait() for true async submission
phase8_reference.persistent_buffers: XRT BOs created once, reused across iterations

required_changes: Enable async/events in device caps (async=true, events=true)
Implement XRT event interface (event_new, event_free, event_record, event_wait, event_synchronize)
Implement synchronize to wait for pending operations
Connect backend to persistent engine with xclbin/insts paths
Use async execution pattern in graph_compute: submit all, then sync
Implement async tensor copy using XRT BO operations

implementation_status.xrt_event_interface: DONE - event_new, event_free, event_synchronize, event_record, event_wait implemented using std::promise/future
implementation_status.graph_compute_async: DONE - submits all ops via persistent_engine_submit, returns immediately
implementation_status.synchronize: DONE - waits for all pending runs via persistent_engine_wait
implementation_status.backend_persistent_engine_connection: DONE - init_xrt called with Phase 8 xclbin/insts paths
implementation_status.async_execution_pattern: DONE - graph_compute calls graph_compute_async then synchronize
implementation_status.async_tensor_copy: PARTIAL - basic memcpy, XRT BO async copy not implemented
